battle.name: 岳州之戰
battle.brief: 至元十二年（1275）秋，元軍伯顏部沿長江西下，另遣偏師溯湘江深入湖南，先取洞庭湖口要衝岳州，再合圍潭州。水戰與攻城都離不開火：宋軍以猛火油製成的火器與火船迎擊，元軍則以回回炮與鐵鎖連船應對。卡面所繪的希臘火，正是這類燃燒利器最早的形制原型。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 大元與南宋在洞庭湖與湘江中游的正面對撞，是元滅宋戰役中南線的一環。元方由大汗忽必烈下詔發動，至元十一年（1274）以伯顏為都元帥，節制荊湖、江西、兩淮各路兵與水軍，兵分數道：伯顏自鄂渚沿長江西下，目標是江陵、鄂州與臨安；同時遣偏師溯湘江而入湖南，先取洞庭湖口、控住湖面，再圖潭州；另設湖廣行省，以阿里海牙總其地，阿術等為前鋒，水路由劉整所造內河戰艦與海運船隊分擔運糧。蒙古軍中漢軍比例甚高，攻城器械多出漢軍工匠之手，牧民騎兵則用於包抄與追擊。宋方是仍據半壁的南宋朝廷，樞密院與兩浙西路、荊湖南路的地方軍政體系分擔防務：江淮、兩浙、江西之兵被抽調東下支援江防，湖南則以潭州城為樞、岳州為北面門戶，築城守湖、屯糧以待。四川已於端平年間失去，襄樊亦於至元十年（1273）陷落，江防退到鄂州一線。此外，洞庭湖區自1275年起有鍾相、楊二者起義，聚眾佔據湖中洲渚，與官軍互相攻殺，使南面的糧源與兵力調動更加混亂。這場戰爭因此是三股力量在同一片水面與山嶺之間的角力。
countriesEn: The confrontation between the Great Yuan and Southern Song on Dongting Lake and the middle reaches of the Xiang River was one front of the Yuan campaign to destroy Song. On the Yuan (Mongol) side the campaign was set in motion by the Great Khan Kublai; in 1274, the eleventh year of the Zhiyuan era, he made Bayan supreme commander over the troops and fleets of Jinghu, Jiangxi and Lianghuai, and the army was split into several prongs. Bayan moved down the Yangtze from Ezhou with his main body, aiming at Jiangling, at Ezhou and finally at Lin'an. At the same time a detached force was sent up the Xiang River into Hunan, first seizing the outlet of Dongting Lake, taking control of the water, and only then turning on Tanzhou. A Huguang provincial administration was set up with Ariq Qacha in overall charge and Asu among the vanguard, while the river route and the grain traffic were carried by the inland war fleet built by Liu Zheng together with the sea-borne grain convoys. Han Chinese troops made up a large share of the Mongol army and supplied most of the siege engines, while the pastoral cavalry was used for encirclement and pursuit. The Song side was the Southern Song court, still holding half of the empire. The Bureau of Military Affairs and the regional administrations of the Liangzhe West and Jinghu South circuits shared the defence: troops from Jianghuai, Liangzhe and Jiangxi were pulled eastward to support the river defences, while Hunan relied on the fortified city of Tanzhou as its hub and on Yuezhou as the northern gateway, with walls built and grain stored to guard the lake. Sichuan had been lost since the Duanping era, and Xiangyang and Fancheng had fallen in 1273, so the river defences had been pulled back to the Ezhou line. In addition, from 1275 the uprising of Zhong Xiang and Yang Erzi held islands and shoals in the Dongting lake area; their bands fought the Song officials and each other, further muddying the supply of grain and the movement of troops in Hunan. This battle was therefore a three-cornered struggle for the same stretch of water and hills.
people: 忽必烈是發動者。他自1260年即位，1271年建國號大元，滅宋是既定國策；至元十一年下令諸路出兵，翌年再下詔令伯顏等人速取江南。伯顏是全線統帥，早年在西征中以驍勇著稱，一二四○年代曾率軍攻宋兩淮、荊湖，熟悉襄漢與江淮之間的江湖水道與糧道，這次督軍順流而下，攻城與水戰並重。阿術與阿里海牙是湖南方面的前線將領：阿術是伯顏的老部將，驍於先鋒；阿里海牙奉命總湖廣行省，統兵溯湘江，主持取岳州、圍潭州的戰事。劉整是最關鍵的技術人物之一，這位漢人降將在1270年前後受命大造戰艦，內河船隊成為蒙古軍在長江中下游賴以存在的支撐，他於至元十二年病逝，部眾仍沿用其造船與水戰編制；董文炳、張榮一系領漢軍舟師，專司江面攻擊與糧運護衛。宋廷的主角是丞相賈似道，他早年以阻止北伐、輸歲幣求和知名，後主持用兵，1274年鄂州失守後才督軍江上；1275年二月丁家洲一役宋軍大敗，賈似道退保揚州、議和不成，隨即罷相，但朝廷仍倚其為屏障。湖南方面的守將以潭州守臣李廷之最為人知，他主持潭州城防直至城破。鍾相、楊二者則是洞庭湖區起義的首領，一度聚眾數萬，把官軍的後方攪亂。
peopleEn: Kublai Khan was the man who started it. Seated since 1260 and styling himself founder of the Great Yuan in 1271, he made the destruction of Song a settled policy; in the eleventh year of the Zhiyuan era he ordered the various routes to mobilise, and in the following year he urged Bayan and his commanders to take Jiangnan quickly. Bayan was the overall commander, a leader long famed for ferocity in the western campaigns; in the 1240s he had already campaigned against Song in Lianghuai and Jinghu and knew the rivers, lakes and grain roads between the Xiang-Han region and Jianghuai, and this time he supervised the advance down the river, weighing siege operations and river fighting together. Asu and Ariq Qacha were the frontline commanders in Hunan. Asu was an old subordinate of Bayan's and bold as a vanguard; Ariq Qacha was charged with the Huguang provincial administration and led the troops up the Xiang River, directing the operations that took Yuezhou and besieged Tanzhou. Liu Zheng was among the most important technical figures of the campaign: this Chinese defector was set to build large numbers of war ships around 1270, and his inland fleet became the backbone on which the Mongol presence in the middle and lower Yangtze rested. He died of illness in the twelfth year of the Zhiyuan era, 1275, but his shipbuilding organisation and river tactics carried on under his subordinates. Dong Wenbing and Zhang Rong led Han Chinese river troops charged with striking on the river and escorting grain. On the Song side the central figure was the chancellor Jia Sidao, long known for halting northern expeditions and buying peace with annual tribute. He later took charge of the war, and only after the loss of Ezhou in 1274 did he personally supervise the armies on the river. In the second month of 1275 the Song were badly beaten at Dingjia Zhou; Jia withdrew to Yangzhou, his peace overtures were rejected, and he was removed as chancellor, though the court still leaned on him as a shield. In Hunan the best-known defender was the garrison commander Li Tingzhi, who held Tanzhou until the city fell. Zhong Xiang and Yang Erzi led the Dongting uprising and at one point gathered tens of thousands of followers, wrecking the Song rear.
kits: 卡面上的希臘火是拜占庭帝國的招牌裝備：相傳七世紀末君士坦丁堡的工匠把混有生石灰的燃燒劑灌進銅管，以虹吸管推出，點燃後在水上也不熄滅，最初用在帝國與阿拉伯人爭奪地中海的戰役。配方是帝國的祕密，配方隨船沉沒之後，再無成建制的希臘火裝備存世。到1275年，拜占庭的銅管噴火器早已失傳，蒙古與南宋的湖南戰場上沒有任何希臘火；真正對位的，是東亞火油武器的兩條支線。南宋自北宋以來就備有猛火油，即從石油中煉出的可燃稠液，灌入陶罐或木桶的猛火油櫃，用投石機擲出，或直接灑在攻城塔、戰船與糧車上，遇水不滅、遇火即烈；配合火藥爆竹、火球與火箭，構成宋軍對付蒙古攻城器械的常設手段。元軍的攻城火器則以回回炮為主，即配重式投石機，由襄陽歸降的西域工匠阿老瓦丁等所傳，砲石重數百斤至逾千斤，一次齊射可以崩壞城樓、塔樓與城垣；再加上撞竿、雲梯、望車、巢車與就城的濠塹，組成完整的攻城器械體系。水戰方面，元軍舟師以鐵鎖把戰船連成一列，藉此穩住船身、防止宋軍火船衝撞，並以長矛、標槍、弓弩與拋石拒敵；糧食靠內河戰艦與海運大船沿海路運到江口，再轉入湘江。輕兵器方面，蒙古騎兵用角弓與長矛，漢軍步卒用長刀、長槍與破陣刀，南宋水師則有樓船、車船、鬥艦與海鰍等船型，這些船型在南宋造船業中早已成型，岳州之戰的舟師即由這一套技術底子支撐。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on the card is the signature equipment of the Byzantine Empire. Legend has it that at the end of the seventh century craftsmen in Constantinople filled bronze siphons with a burning mixture containing quicklime, which was forced out by pressure, lit and burned even on the surface of the water; it was first used in the empire's wars with the Arabs for the possession of the Mediterranean. The formula was a state secret, and after the formula went down with the ships there survived no organised Greek fire apparatus anywhere. By 1275 the bronze siphon of Byzantium had long since disappeared; there was no Greek fire on the Hunan battlefield of the Mongols and the Southern Song. What stood opposite to it were the two branches of East Asian fire-oil weaponry. Song had kept the so-called fierce oil since the Northern Song, a combustible thick liquid boiled out of petroleum, poured into earthen jars or wooden tubs in what were called fierce-oil chests, and thrown by catapult or splashed directly onto siege towers, war ships and grain carts, burning fiercely and not quenched by water; combined with firework bombs, fireballs and incendiary arrows, it formed a standing Song method against Mongol siege equipment. The principal fire weapon of the Yuan assault was the counterweight trebuchet, the so-called Huihui pao, taught by western craftsmen such as Ala al-Din who surrendered at Xiangyang; its stones weighed several hundred jin and in the heaviest cases more than a thousand, and a single salvo could shatter gate towers, tall towers and curtain walls. Together with battering rams, scaling ladders, observation carts, siege towers and the ditches dug close to the walls, these formed a complete siege train. In river fighting the Yuan flotilla lashed its vessels together with iron chains, both to steady the hulls and to stop Song fire ships from ramming them, and answered with long spears, javelins, bows and thrown stones; grain was moved by inland war ships and by large sea convoys to the mouth of the river and then transferred to the Xiang. In the light arms the Mongol cavalry used composite bows and long spears, Han infantry used long swords, long spears and heavy-bladed breaching knives, and the Song fleets had such types as tower ships, wheeled ships, fighting junks and sea swallows, all long established in Song shipbuilding; the fleets that fought over Yuezhou rested on exactly that technological base.
tactics: 元軍的整體打法是分進合擊、水陸並用。伯顏主力自北面沿長江壓下，湖南偏師自西面溯湘江而上，兩線在洞庭湖口與鄂、潭之間形成南北夾擊，務求先奪水口，斷絕湖南與江西的往來。取岳州正是為此：岳州控洞庭入長江之門，奪之則湖面歸元軍舟師所有，糧道與援兵線同時被打斷。攻城序列是蒙古的老辦法：先以回回炮自遠處連續轟擊城樓與城頭，消耗守軍、壓制射界，再以撞竿破門、雲梯突登；圍城同時不忘斷糧與反覆出擊，企圖在守軍耗盡之前迫其出降。水戰上，元軍把戰船鐵鎖相連，一列船隊即是一列浮動的堡壘，可以停在江心不退，也不怕對方火船貼上來放火；遇宋舟師攔截，則以弩箭、標槍與火油潑灑驅離，並在夜裡派小船焚燒宋軍外泊的船隻與糧船。宋軍則以城自守。潭州守軍依城垣、谿塹與城頭射位分層抵抗，砲擊則以回回炮與自家所造的霹靂炮（以火藥竹筒配石彈與毒煙）回敬，試圖打擊元軍的砲位與攻城塔；出城反擊時以猛火油潑灑攻城器械，趁夜放火船衝擊元軍水寨。援軍方面，江西、湖北方向曾奉命北上解潭州之圍，或逗留觀望、或遇元軍即潰，無法真正接近被圍城池。洞庭湖區的起義武裝同時牽制了宋方從湖面調兵運糧的可能，使守軍的補給愈發緊絀。
tacticsEn: The Yuan method was to attack in divided columns and converge, using water and land together. Bayan's main body pressed down the Yangtze from the north while the Hunan detachment moved up the Xiang River from the west, so that the two lines closed on the outlet of Dongting Lake and on the ground between Ezhou and Tanzhou; the object was to seize the waterways first and cut Hunan off from Jiangxi. Taking Yuezhou served exactly that purpose: Yuezhou commands the mouth where Dongting empties into the Yangtze, and once it was lost the lake itself belonged to the Yuan fleets, and the grain road and the line of reinforcement were broken together. The siege followed the established Mongol sequence: first the counterweight trebuchets battered the gate towers and the parapet from a distance, wearing down the garrison and suppressing its firing positions, then battering rams were set against the gates and scaling ladders went up; throughout the blockade the besiegers also worked to starve the city and to strike again and again, hoping the garrison would surrender before it was exhausted. In river fighting the Yuan lashed its ships together with iron chains, so that a line of vessels became a line of floating bastions that could hold station mid-river and could not be set alight by a fire ship lashed alongside; when Song fleets tried to intercept, the Yuan answered with crossbow bolts, javelins and splashed oil, and at night sent small boats to burn the Song vessels moored outside and their grain boats. The Song fought from the city. The garrison of Tanzhou held in layers behind the walls, the ditches and the firing positions on the parapet, answered the bombardment with their own counterweight trebuchets and with the thunder crash bombs they had manufactured, bamboo tubes charged with gunpowder and stone or smoke, trying to hit the Yuan gun positions and the siege towers; when they sallied out they splashed fierce oil over the siege equipment and sent fire ships against the Yuan water camps at night. Relief troops were ordered north from Jiangxi and Hubei to lift the siege of Tanzhou, but either hung back and watched or broke up at the sight of the Yuan, and never came near the besieged city. Meanwhile the insurgents in the Dongting area tied down the Song's ability to move troops and grain across the lake, tightening the garrison's supply line still further.
data: 能核到的數字有限，且多為史家概說，不宜當作實數。元滅宋的兵力量級，一般記伯顏統軍二十萬上下順流東下；湖南方面的偏師則是數萬之眾，有概說五萬者。地理上，岳州城在洞庭湖東口、與長江交會之處，江面在枯水期寬逾一公里、寬處數公里；自岳州溯湘江至潭州，水路約二百五十公里，舟師逆流行駛，日行僅數十里，糧秣須沿途分批轉運。洞庭湖水面廣逾二千五百平方公里，湖內洲渚極多，舟船通行須依賴熟悉湖汊的嚮導。時序上，至元十一年（1274）冬伯顏取鄂州；至元十二年（1275）正月宋軍在池州至銅陵一線失利，二月丁家洲再敗；同年秋，一般繫於九月前後，岳州落入元軍之手，潭州自十一月起被圍，至翌年（1276）春城破，歷時四個多月。器械方面，回回炮的砲石常重數百斤，重的逾千斤，一次齊射可覆蓋城頭大片區域。城破之日，潭州守軍多戰死或被俘，確數無從核實；湖南各州如常德、澧州、衡州、寶慶等則多望風而降，這些都是城池數而非兵員數。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, and most of them are general statements by historians rather than true counts, so they should not be treated as exact. On the scale of the Yuan forces, the usual record is that Bayan commanded some two hundred thousand men as he moved down the river; the detached force in Hunan numbered several tens of thousands, with a general estimate of fifty thousand. Geographically, the city of Yuezhou stands at the eastern outlet of Dongting Lake where it meets the Yangtze; in the low-water season the river is more than a kilometre wide in places and several kilometres at the widest. From Yuezhou upstream along the Xiang to Tanzhou the water route is about two hundred and fifty kilometres, and a fleet moving against the current makes only a few tens of li a day, so grain had to be shifted forward in stages along the way. The surface of Dongting Lake covers well over two thousand five hundred square kilometres, its shoals and islets are countless, and vessels could only pass with the help of pilots who knew the channels. In sequence: in the winter of 1274 Bayan took Ezhou; in the first month of 1275 the Song were worsted on the line from Chizhou to Tongling, and in the second month suffered the heavier defeat at Dingjia Zhou; in the autumn of the same year, generally dated to around the ninth month, Yuezhou fell to the Yuan, and Tanzhou was invested from the eleventh month, holding out until the city fell in the spring of 1276 after more than four months of siege. As for equipment, the stones of the counterweight trebuchets commonly weighed several hundred jin and in the heaviest cases more than a thousand, and a single salvo could cover a wide stretch of the parapet. On the day the city fell most of the Tanzhou garrison was killed or taken prisoner, and the exact numbers cannot be established; the other Hunan prefectures, such as Changde, Lizhou, Hengzhou and Baoqing, mostly submitted without a fight, and those are counts of cities rather than of men.
cause: 導火線有三層。最外層是宋元之間拖了近半個世紀的邊境協議：端平入洛之後，蒙古南下之勢已成，賈似道主持的南宋朝廷一面以輸歲幣、稱臣、劃界換取安寧，一面把襄樊一線守成鐵壁，蒙古屢次要求交出襄陽不果，遂於1260年代末陸續用兵；1271年忽必烈建元，舊約失效，南北兩套體制正式對立。第二層是地理與戰略：荊湖與湖南是南宋的產糧區與上游屏障，控住湘江便能切斷江西糧道；而宋廷在襄樊失守（1273）之後已喪失漢水與江防樞紐，鄂州暴露，元軍得以順流而下，把戰線一路推到湖南門戶。第三層在湖南本地：1275年鍾相、楊二者起義在洞庭湖區聚眾起事，佔據湖中，與官軍對抗，令守軍既無湖面可用，也難從後方徵發船糧。賈似道主持的朝廷在丁家洲敗後求和不成，主戰與主和都失靈，戰爭於是只能被動地由北向南一路打下去，岳州遂成第一個被撞破的門板。
causeEn: The outbreak had three layers. The outermost was the border settlement that had dragged on for nearly half a century between Song and the Mongols: after the Duanping advance on Luoyang the southward pressure of the Mongols was already established, and the Southern Song court under Jia Sidao bought peace in one way by paying annual tribute, acknowledging vassalage and fixing a frontier, and in another by holding Xiangyang and Fancheng as an iron wall; the Mongols repeatedly demanded the surrender of Xiangyang without success and went on campaign from the late 1260s. In 1271 Kublai proclaimed the Yuan, the old arrangement lapsed, and two rival systems stood formally opposed. The second layer was geography and strategy: Jinghu and Hunan were the grain-producing regions and the upstream shield of the Southern Song, and control of the Xiang River meant cutting the grain road to Jiangxi. After the loss of Xiangyang and Fancheng in 1273 the Song had lost the hinge of the Han River and of the river defences, Ezhou lay exposed, and the Yuan was able to move down the river and push the front all the way to the Hunan gateway. The third layer lay in Hunan itself: in 1275 the revolt of Zhong Xiang and Yang Erzi broke out in the Dongting lake area, occupying the lake and fighting the officials, so that the defenders had no water to use and found it hard to requisition boats and grain from the rear. After the defeat at Dingjia Zhou, Jia Sidao's court failed in its peace overtures, and both the war party and the peace party were discredited; the war could then only be fought passively, from north to south, and Yuezhou became the first door to be broken down.
impact: 岳州與潭州接連陷落，改變的是整個南中國的地理格局。湖南全省的糧源、兵源與船廠歸入元朝，湘江—長江—珠江的水路連成一條可以直下嶺南的運兵通道，這條通道在往後十餘年裡一直是元軍收拾南宋殘局的幹線。為掩護這條線，元朝在湖南設行省，把原宋的荊湖南路與廣南路部分州縣重新編制，行政劃分從此改以行省為骨架。更直接的後果在宋廷：湖南既失，江南只剩兩浙、江西、福建、廣東一線可用，1276年正月臨安開城投降，其後宋室輾轉福州、溫州出海，1279年崖山之役後南宋徹底覆亡。岳州之戰的意義，就在於它是把長江中游的兩扇門一併打開、令宋廷再無縱深可守的那幾場戰役之一。對水戰技術而言，這幾年也把江南的造船與火器累積付之流水：元軍在湖南、江西接連徵用宋地船匠與船料，許多南宋造出的樓船、鬥艦與海鰍在江面被焚或被拆毀，技術傳承隨之斷續，此後很長一段時間，中原的內河海軍都靠蒙古帶來的北方與西域船匠重新摸索。
impactEn: The fall of Yuezhou and then of Tanzhou changed the geography of all southern China. The grain, the manpower and the shipyards of Hunan passed to the Yuan, and the Xiang-Yangtze-Pearl waterway was joined into a single line of march straight down to Lingnan, a line that would remain the main artery through which the Yuan armies collected the remnants of the Southern Song for more than a decade afterwards. To cover that line the Yuan set up provincial administrations in Hunan, redistributing the prefectures and counties of the former Jinghu South and Guangnan South circuits, and from then on the framework of the empire's administration was the xingzheng, the provincial administration. The more direct consequences fell on the Song court: with Hunan gone, only Liangzhe, Jiangxi, Fujian and Guangdong remained in the south, Lin'an opened its gates and surrendered in the first month of 1276, the Song house afterwards moved through Fuzhou and Wenzhou and put to sea, and the Southern Song was destroyed for good after the battle of Yamen in 1279. The meaning of the battle of Yuezhou lies precisely in its being one of the engagements that threw open both doors of the middle Yangtze at once and left the Song court with no depth to fall back on. As for river technology, these years also sent the accumulated shipbuilding and firepower of the south down the drain: the Yuan levied shipwrights and timber in Hunan and Jiangxi in succession, many Song-built tower ships, fighting junks and sea swallows were burned on the water or broken up for parts, and the chain of transmission was broken with them, so that for a long time afterwards the inland fleets of the central plains had to be rebuilt by northern and western craftsmen the Mongols had brought with them.
result: 結果是元軍在湖南全面得手。1275年秋，岳州失守，洞庭湖口與湘江下游盡入元軍之手，元軍舟師得以駛入洞庭，糧道與援兵線從此斷絕；同年十一月起圍攻潭州，經四個多月，至1276年春城破，潭州守軍大部戰死或被俘，李廷之等守臣與將士殉城，湖南各州隨後望風而降，荊湖南路大部平定。元軍因此在長江中游取得了與伯顏主力東進相配合的翼側控制，兩軍一西一東，夾住江南：1276年正月伯顏進入臨安，宋廷奉上傳國璽降元，元軍佔領江浙；其後宋室南逃海上，經崖山之役被消滅。就兵器與戰術而言，這場戰役留下的經驗是：攻水路上的重鎮，靠的未必是單件的神兵，而是舟船、砲石、火油與糧道組合成的一整套系統。希臘火那樣的燃燒劑在十三世紀已無實物，但它留下的思路——把可燃物送到對方的船或器械上——卻在這幾年裡以猛火油櫃、火船與火箭的形式，在洞庭湖面反覆被驗證。
resultEn: The outcome was an outright Yuan success in Hunan. In the autumn of 1275 Yuezhou fell, the outlet of Dongting Lake and the lower Xiang passed to the Yuan, the Yuan fleets could sail into the lake, and the grain road and the line of reinforcement were cut for good. Tanzhou was invested from the eleventh month of the same year and, after more than four months, fell in the spring of 1276; most of the garrison was killed or taken prisoner, Li Tingzhi and other officers and soldiers died with the city, and the Hunan prefectures surrendered in turn, bringing most of the Jinghu South circuit to an end. The Yuan thus gained control of the middle Yangtze on the flank of Bayan's eastward main body, the two armies pressing from the west and from the east and pinching the south: in the first month of 1276 Bayan entered Lin'an, the Song court handed over the imperial seals and surrendered, and the Yuan took possession of Jiangnan; the Song house then fled south to the sea and was finally destroyed at Yamen. As to weapons and tactics, the lesson of this campaign was that in storming a strong city on a water route one relies less on any single wonder-weapon than on an entire system assembled from hulls, stones, fire oil and the grain road. A burning agent such as Greek fire had long since ceased to exist as a physical thing in the thirteenth century, but the idea behind it, carrying the combustible to the enemy's ships or siege engines, was tested again and again on the waters of Dongting in the form of the fierce-oil chest, the fire ship and the incendiary arrow.
